args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades the fastjson dependency from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4.

## Security
Fixes CVE-2026-31337 (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. Affected versions: <2.9.4. Fixed in 2.9.4.

## Changes
- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4`
- `CHANGELOG.md`: changelog entry under Unreleased

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` passed on branch `fix/fastjson-cve-2026-31337` (commit e3c697df0f).
